74: public class HandleNonNull extends JavacAnnotationHandler<NonNull> {
75: 	private JCMethodDecl createRecordArgslessConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source, JCMethodDecl existingCtr) {
76: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
77: 		
78: 		java.util.List<JCVariableDecl> fields = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
79: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
80: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
81: 				JCVariableDecl v = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
82: 				if ((v.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
83: 					fields.add(v);
84: 				}
85: 			}
86: 		}
87: 		
88: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
89: 		
90: 		for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
91: 			JCVariableDecl arg = fields.get(i);
92: 			JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(GENERATED_MEMBER | Flags.PARAMETER, arg.mods.annotations);
93: 			params.append(maker.VarDef(mods, arg.name, arg.vartype, null));
94: 		}
95: 		
96: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(AccessLevel.PUBLIC) | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
97: 		JCBlock body = maker.Block(0L, List.<JCStatement>nil());
98: 		if (existingCtr == null) {
99: 			JCMethodDecl constr = maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"), null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), body, null);
100: 			return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(constr, source);
101: 		} else {
102: 			existingCtr.mods = mods;
103: 			existingCtr.body = body;
104: 			existingCtr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(existingCtr, source);
105: 			addSuppressWarningsAll(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
106: 			addGenerated(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
107: 			return existingCtr;
108: 		}
109: 	}
110: 	
111: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
112: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE, "@NonNull");
113: 
114: 		List<JCMethodDecl> methodsNeedingNullCheck = List.nil();
115: 		JavacNode variableNode = null;
116: 
117: 		if (annotationNode.up().getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
118: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
119: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
120: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
121: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
122: 
123: 			try {
124: 				JCExpression fieldType = ((JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get()).vartype;
125: 				if (JavaIdentifiers.isPrimitive(fieldType.toString())) {
126: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
127: 				}
128: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
129: 
130: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = (JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get();
131: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) == 0) return;
132: 
133: 			// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
134: 			JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up().up();
135: 			List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = List.nil();
136: 			if (typeNode != null && typeNode.get() instanceof JCClassDecl) {
137: 				JCClassDecl cDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
138: 				if ((cDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
139: 					boolean generateConstructor = false;
140: 					JCMethodDecl existingCtr = null;
141: 					for (JCTree def : cDecl.defs) {
142: 						if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
143: 							JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
144: 							if (!md.name.contentEquals("<init>")) continue;
145: 							if ((md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
146: 								existingCtr = md;
147: 								existingCtr.mods.flags = existingCtr.mods.flags & ~Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR;
148: 								generateConstructor = true;
149: 							} else if (!isTolerate(typeNode, md) && (md.mods.flags & COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR) != 0) {
150: 								generateConstructor = false;
151: 								compactConstructors = compactConstructors.prepend(md);
152: 							}
153: 						}
154: 					}
155: 					if (generateConstructor) {
156: 						JCMethodDecl ctr;
157: 						if (existingCtr != null) {
158: 							ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, annotationNode, existingCtr);
159: 						} else {
160: 							ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, annotationNode, null);
161: 							injectMethod(typeNode, ctr);
162: 						}
163: 						compactConstructors = compactConstructors.prepend(ctr);
164: 					}
165: 				}
166: 			}
167: 			methodsNeedingNullCheck = compactConstructors;
168: 			variableNode = annotationNode.up();
169: 		} else {
170: 			JavacNode paramNode;
171: 			switch (annotationNode.up().getKind()) {
172: 			case ARGUMENT:
173: 				paramNode = annotationNode.up();
174: 				break;
175: 			case TYPE_USE:
176: 				JavacNode typeUseNode = annotationNode.directUp();
177: 				paramNode = typeUseNode.directUp();
178: 				break;
179: 			default:
180: 				return;
181: 			}
182: 
183: 			if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
184: 			JCMethodDecl declaration;
185: 			try {
186: 				declaration = (JCMethodDecl) paramNode.up().get();
187: 			} catch (Exception e) {
188: 				return;
189: 			}
190: 
191: 			if (declaration.body == null) {
192: 				// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
193: 				return;
194: 			}
195: 
196: 			if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
197: 				// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
198: 				// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
199: 				// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
200: 				return;
201: 			}
202: 
203: 			methodsNeedingNullCheck = methodsNeedingNullCheck.prepend(declaration);
204: 			variableNode = paramNode;
205: 		}
206: 
207: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = annotationNode.getTreeMaker();
208: 		for (JCMethodDecl method : methodsNeedingNullCheck) {
209: 			JCVariableDecl variableDecl = (JCVariableDecl) variableNode.get();
210: 			JCStatement generatedCheck = generateNullCheck(maker, variableDecl.vartype, variableDecl.name, annotationNode, null);
211: 			JCStatement nullCheck = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(generatedCheck, annotationNode);
212: 			if (nullCheck == null) {
213: 				annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
214: 				continue;
215: 			}
216: 
217: 			List<JCStatement> statements = method.body.stats;
218: 			String expectedName = variableNode.getName();
219: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
220: 			int idx = 0;
221: 			boolean alreadyPresent = false;
222: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
223: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
224: 				if (isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
225: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {
226: 					stats = ((JCTry) stat).body.stats;
227: 					idx = 0;
228: 					continue;
229: 				}
230: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
231: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;
232: 					idx = 0;
233: 					continue;
234: 				}
235: 				String varNameOfNullCheck = returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat);
236: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck == null) break;
237: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) {
238: 					alreadyPresent = true;
239: 					break;
240: 				}
241: 			}
242: 			if (alreadyPresent) continue;
243: 
244: 			List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
245: 			List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
246: 			for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
247: 				if (isConstructorCall(stat) || (isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
248: 					tail = tail.tail;
249: 					head = head.prepend(stat);
250: 					continue;
251: 				}
252: 				break;
253: 			}
254: 
255: 			List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
256: 			for (JCStatement stat : head) {
257: 				newList = newList.prepend(stat);
258: 			}
259: 			method.body.stats = newList;
260: 			annotationNode.getAst().setChanged();
261: 		}
262: 	}

264: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
265: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
266: 	}
267: 	
268: 	/**
269: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
270: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
271: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
272: 	 */
273: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
274: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
275: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
276: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
277: 		
278: 		if (isExpression) {
279: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
280: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
281: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
282: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
283: 			
284: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
285: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
286: 			Name name = null;
287: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
288: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
289: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
290: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
291: 			}
292: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
293: 			
294: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
295: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
296: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
297: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
298: 		}
299: 		
300: 		if (isIf) {
301: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
302: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
303: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
304: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
305: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
306: 				then = stats.get(0);
307: 			}
308: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
309: 		}
310: 		
311: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
312: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
313: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
314: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
315: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
316: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
317: 			if (isIf) {
318: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
319: 			} else {
320: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
321: 			}
322: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
323: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
324: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
325: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
326: 		}
327: 	}

The fix is complete and validated. Summary:

**Root cause:** When `@NonNull` is written in type-use position on a record component (e.g. `byte @NonNull[] bytes`), the annotation node's `up()` resolves to a `TYPE_USE` node rather than the field. In both `HandleNonNull` handlers, that path computed the parent node and only accepted `Kind.ARGUMENT`, so the record-component `FIELD` case was silently dropped and no null-check was added to the record's canonical constructor.

**Changes:**
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleNonNull.java` — restructured `handle()` so the resolved variable node can be either `ARGUMENT` or `FIELD`. Type-use annotations on record components now flow into the shared record-field path (compact constructor generation + null check), while annotations nested on inner array dimensions (`int[] @NonNull[] c`, where the annotation doesn't apply to the variable itself) still bail out via a `TYPE_USE` parent check.
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleNonNull.java` — same fix for ecj via a new `getFieldNodeForAnnotation()` helper used in both the diet-parse phase (to create the compact constructor) and `handle0()` (to add the null check).

**Validation:**
- `ant test.instance` (TestWithDelombok): `javac-NonNullOnRecordTypeUse` now passes; only the 4 pre-existing baseline failures remain (`BuilderSingularOnRecord`, `FieldNameConstantsOnRecord`, `WithByOnRecordComponent`, `WithOnRecordComponent` — all failed before my change and are unrelated to `@NonNull`).
- `ant test.eclipse-202212` (TestWithEcj): all 332 tests pass, including `ecj-NonNullOnRecordTypeUse`.

For the issue's repro, delombok now produces `if (b == null) throw new NullPointerException("b is marked non-null but is null")` in the canonical constructor, so `new NamedByteArray("name", null)` throws `NullPointerException`.
